// A deck with a sticker sheet, an attraction deck and a planar deck stapled to
// it. None of that is ever shuffled into the library, but the text export has no
// way to say so -- only the type line does.
//
// The library is 44: 40 Forests, two planeswalkers, and the two real cards that
// apply stickers. Everything below them leaves, and has to say that it did.
1x Marwyn, the Nurturer [Commander{top}]

40x Forest [Land]
1x Vivien Reid [Draw]
1x Nissa, Who Shakes the World [Payoff]

// Real cards, filed under the category Archidekt gives them. Matching the
// category name would drop them; matching "Plane" as a substring would drop the
// two planeswalkers above.
1x Park Bleater [Sticker Package]
1x Ticketomaton [Sticker Package]

// One of each type that lives in its own deck or zone.
1x Ancestral Hot Dog Minotaur [Sticker Package]
3x Bumper Cars [Attractions]
